policy.requirement: The site must clearly and prominently state: "As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases."
policy.quote: You must clearly and prominently state the following, or any substantially similar statement previously allowed under this Agreement, on your Site or any other location where Amazon may authorize your display or other use of Program Content: “As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.”
policy.howMet: Printed verbatim under the masthead on every page, and repeated in the footer of every page.

policy.requirement: Disclosure must be hard to miss and placed with the endorsement, not buried on an about page or at the end of the page.
policy.quote: Make sure people will see and understand the disclosure. Place it so it’s hard to miss. The disclosure should be placed with the endorsement message itself. Disclosures are likely to be missed if they appear only on an ABOUT ME or profile page, at the end of posts or videos, or anywhere that requires a person to click MORE.
policy.howMet: Disclosure sits in a strip directly under the masthead, above all content, before any product appears.

policy.requirement: Customer reviews and star ratings may not be displayed without obtaining them through the Creatives API or PA API.
policy.quote: You will not display or otherwise use any of our customer reviews or star ratings, in part or in whole, on your Site unless you have obtained a link to that customer review or star rating through Creators API or PA API and you comply with the requirements for Creators API and PA API described in the License
policy.howMet: No star ratings or review excerpts appear anywhere on the site. Rating and review-count fields are deliberately withheld and shown as withheld, not blank-to-be-filled.

policy.requirement: Prices must come from Amazon's API to remain accurate; the site must not run price tracking or alerting.
policy.quote: Unless otherwise agreed by Amazon, your Site must not have price tracking and/or price alerting functionality.
policy.howMet: No prices are shown and no price history, drop alerts, or price comparison over time exists. Price fields are marked unverified.

policy.requirement: Outbound links must make it clear the visitor is going to Amazon; the destination must not be obscured.
policy.quote: You will not use a link shortening service, button, hyperlink or other ad placement in a manner that makes it unclear that you are linking to an Amazon Site.
policy.howMet: Every buy button is a plain link to amazon.com/dp/<ASIN> with the tracking tag, labelled with the word Amazon, and marked rel="sponsored". No redirector and no link shortener sits between the reader and Amazon.

policy.requirement: Do not imply that Amazon or a brand sponsors, endorses, or is affiliated with the site.
policy.quote: You will not misrepresent or embellish our relationship with you (including by expressing or implying that we support, sponsor, or endorse you)
policy.howMet: No Amazon logo, badge, or trademark artwork is used. The site states plainly that it is reader-supported and independent.

policy.requirement: You may not describe hands-on experience with a product the author has not used.
policy.quote: You can’t talk about your experience with a product you haven’t tried.
policy.howMet: No page claims testing, owning, or using any product. Recommendations are framed as how to decide, drawn from stated specifications. The About page says this explicitly.

policy.requirement: Do not bid on or purchase Amazon trademarks or misspellings as search keywords.
policy.quote: You will not bid on or purchase keywords, search terms, or other identifiers, including the word “amazon,” Kindle,” or any other trademark of Amazon
policy.howMet: No paid search is run by this site. The SEO section documents this restriction so a future session does not create an Amazon-branded ad campaign.

policy.requirement: Disclosure placement and endorsement context should be reviewed against the Operating Agreement and FTC guidance before publishing.
policy.quote: You will be solely responsible for the content on your Site
policy.howMet: The build script fails the build if any HTML page lacks the disclosure strip, the footer statement, or a sponsored-marked outbound link. Nothing publishes unchecked.

policy.requirement: Program Content may not be altered, stored, or hot-linked; it must come through approved tools.
policy.quote: You will not add to, delete from, or otherwise alter any Program Content in any way
policy.howMet: No Amazon-hosted images, descriptions, or Program Content are copied onto the site. Product pages describe form factor and trade-offs in our own words.
